Associate AI Engineer
Job Title: Associate AI Engineer
Location: Bangalore
Department: Technology
Experience : 1-4 years (relevant)

About Digital Green
Digital Green is a pioneer global not for profit organization, utilizing digital platforms and community-driven approaches to amplify the voices of smallholder farmers and improve their livelihoods. Our mission is to create a world where farmers use technology and data to build prosperous communities. By harnessing the power of technology, we facilitate knowledge sharing, capacity building, and market linkages, enabling farmers to adopt sustainable agricultural practices and increase their productivity and income.

We are dedicated to transforming the lives of under-served smallholder farmers worldwide through innovative technology solutions. Backed by leading philanthropic organizations such as the Bill & Melinda Gates Foundation (BMGF), Walmart Foundation, USAID, and UK Foreign, Commonwealth & Development Office (UKFCDO), we are committed to leveraging data and technology to empower smallholder farmers and strengthen agricultural extension systems.
Job Summary
LLMs Embeddings Evaluation Agentic Systems Multi-Modal AI
The Associate AI Engineer will build and evaluate LLM-powered features for FarmerChat, Digital Greens conversational AI platform serving millions of smallholder farmers. We are seeking an engineer with Python skills and hands-on LLM experience to design, test, and monitor AI systems that work reliably in multilingual, low-resource, and real-world agricultural contexts. Youll rotate across feature development, evaluation testing, and observability depending on sprint priorities gaining broad exposure across the full AI stack.
In this role, you will write and refine prompts, build agentic workflows using tool-use patterns and the Model Context Protocol (MCP), maintain embedding and vector store pipelines, and work with multimodal data (text, speech, image) to serve farmer-facing advisory tools. Youll define and run automated evaluation frameworks to catch hallucination and bias before models ship to production, and collaborate with senior engineers, product, and field teams to ship reliable AI systems. This is a generalist role with genuine mentorship your contributions matter from day one, and youll grow rapidly in a fast-moving, impact-driven team.
Key Responsibilities
1. Build & Integrate LLM Features
Help build features for FarmerChat using LLM provider APIs (Anthropic Claude, OpenAI, Google Gemini) with guidance from senior engineers.
Write and refine prompts, call APIs, and wire up tool-use patterns using provider SDKs and the Model Context Protocol (MCP).
2. Test & Evaluate AI Systems
Run and extend automated test suites that check LLM outputs for accuracy, hallucination, and bias using tools like Ragas, DeepEval, or Promptfoo.
Test agent workflows end-to-end and document edge cases, failure modes, and regressions.
3. Work with Embeddings, Speech & Vision
Help maintain embedding pipelines and vector stores (Qdrant, pgvector, FAISS) that ground LLM responses with relevant agricultural knowledge.
Support the team s expanding multi-modal work - speech-to-text (Whisper, Deepgram), text-to-speech, and image classification for crop and pest detection.
4. Monitor, Debug & Document
Use observability tools (Langfuse, Arize Phoenix, Weights & Biases) to monitor system health and flag issues.
Document your work - prompts, experiments, runbooks - so the team can reproduce and build on it.
Qualification & Skills:
1-4 years in software engineering, ML, data science, or a related AI role.
Bachelor s or Master s in Computer Science, AI/ML, or a related field.
Solid Python skills - comfortable writing code beyond notebooks.
Hands-on experience with at least one LLM provider API (Claude, OpenAI, or Gemini).
Familiarity with prompt engineering basics (few-shot, chain-of-thought, structured output).
Basic understanding of embeddings and vector stores.
Git and collaborative development workflows.
Nice to Have
Exposure to agentic workflows, MCP, or tool-use patterns.
Hands-on with speech models (Whisper, Deepgram) or vision models (ViT, CLIP, YOLO).
Experience with LLM evaluation frameworks (Ragas, DeepEval, Promptfoo).
Cloud platform basics (AWS Bedrock / SageMaker, GCP Vertex AI, or Azure).
Fine-tuning experience (LoRA / PEFT) or open-source LLMs (Gemma, LLaMA, Mistral).
Docker / containerization basics.
What You ll Build
Production features for FarmerChat - a real AI product serving millions of users.
Evaluation pipelines that validate every model update before it ships.
Multi-modal systems spanning text, speech, and image classification for agricultural use cases.
Tools and documentation that make the whole AI team more productive.
Why Digital Green
Real impact - your code helps farmers, not ad clicks.
Broad exposure - you ll build, test, debug, and ship across the full AI stack.
Genuine mentorship from senior engineers.
Small, fast-moving team where your contributions matter from day one.
Compensation and Application Process:

Digital Green is a great place to work and prides itself on a competitive and comprehensive compensation and benefits package. Digital Green Trust is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Please send your application along with an updated CV and a cover letter explaining your suitability for the position. All completed applications should be applied through https: / / digitalgreen.applytojob.com / apply / Wtd9i7fv2k / Associate-AI-Engineer
